scene: A narrow earth path trodden through low grass, receding toward the horizon, seen from the front, with a small person walking away on it, no toad, no animals, plain sky. The path is about as wide as the person's shoulders.
must: a narrow trodden earth way running through grass to the horizon.
avoid: a toad sitting on the earth (pad-dier); a wide road with a line down the middle (not the card); a river (not the card); a fence line (not the card).
contrast: Pair with pad-dier. The only difference is the thing: a trodden way with a person here, a squat amphibian on the same ground there.
example_nl: Dit pad gaat naar het bos.
example_en: This path goes to the forest.
alt: Een smalle platgelopen strook door het gras loopt weg naar de horizon, met een kleine persoon erop.

scene: A squat toad sitting on bare earth in low grass, seen side-on, with a warty rounded body, wide mouth, two bulging eyes and short folded back legs. The same low grass and plain sky as the path scene; no person, no path stretching to the horizon.
must: a squat warty animal with bulging eyes sitting on the ground.
avoid: a long trodden path with a person (pad-weg); a frog with smooth skin and long legs (not the card); a snail (not the card); a lizard (not the card).
contrast: Pair with pad-weg. The only difference is the thing: a squat amphibian here, a trodden way with a person there.
example_nl: Er zit een pad onder de steen.
example_en: There is a toad under the stone.
alt: Een dik, bobbelig dier met bolle ogen zit stil op de aarde tussen het gras.

scene: A rabbit sitting side-on on a flat grass line: a round compact body, a short round head, ears about as long as the head held upright, short hind legs tucked under and a small round fluffy tail. Plain sky, no burrow, no carrot, no person.
must: a round compact body with short upright ears and a small round tail.
avoid: a lean animal with very long ears and long hind legs (haas); a cat (kat); a guinea pig with no visible ears (not the card); a cartoon rabbit holding a carrot (not the card).
contrast: Pair with haas. The only difference is the thing: a round body with short ears here, a lean body with very long ears and long legs there.
example_nl: Het konijn eet graag sla.
example_en: The rabbit likes to eat lettuce.
alt: Een klein rond dier met korte rechtopstaande oren en een bolletje als staart zit in het gras.

scene: A hare sitting side-on on a flat grass line: a lean body, a narrow head, very long upright ears about twice the length of the head, long strong hind legs folded under it and a short tail. Plain sky, no burrow, no person.
must: a lean body with very long upright ears and long hind legs.
avoid: a round compact animal with short ears (konijn); a kangaroo (not the card); a deer (not the card); a dog (hond).
contrast: Pair with konijn. The only difference is the thing: a lean body with very long ears and long legs here, a round body with short ears there.
example_nl: De haas rent hard over het veld.
example_en: The hare runs fast across the field.
alt: Een slank dier met heel lange oren en lange achterpoten zit in het gras.

scene: A shark swimming side-on below a wavy water line: a long tapered body, a pointed snout with a wide mouth line, five slanted gill slits behind the eye, a tall triangular back fin and a tail fin whose upper half is longer than the lower half.
must: a long tapered body with gill slits and a tall triangular back fin.
avoid: a smooth body with a short beak and a blowhole (dolfijn); a whale (not the card); a small fish (vis); an open mouth full of teeth (not the card).
contrast: Pair with dolfijn. The only difference is the thing: a tapered body with gill slits and a pointed snout here, a smooth body with a short beak and a blowhole there.
example_nl: In deze zee zwemt een haai.
example_en: A shark swims in this sea.
alt: Een lang zeedier met een puntige snuit, schuine spleten achter het oog en een hoge driehoekige rugvin zwemt onder water.

scene: A dolphin swimming side-on below a wavy water line: a smooth curved body, a rounded forehead, a short narrow beak with a slight smile line, a blowhole on top of the head, a curved back fin and a flat horizontal tail. No gill slits.
must: a smooth body with a short beak, a rounded forehead and a blowhole.
avoid: a long body with gill slits and a pointed snout (haai); a whale (not the card); a fish (vis); a dolphin jumping out of the water (not the card).
contrast: Pair with haai. The only difference is the thing: a smooth body with a short beak and a blowhole here, a tapered body with gill slits there.
example_nl: De dolfijn zwemt dicht bij de boot.
example_en: The dolphin swims close to the boat.
alt: Een glad zeedier met een korte snavel, een bol voorhoofd en een gat bovenop de kop zwemt onder water.

scene: A butterfly resting on the edge of a plain leaf, seen slightly from the side: a slim body, two large wings folded together upright above the back with simple vein lines, and two thin straight antennae ending in small knobs. No pattern on the wings, no flower.
must: wings folded upright above the body and thin antennae with knobs.
avoid: wings lying flat like a roof with feathery antennae (mot); a bee (not the card); a dragonfly (not the card); a butterfly with a printed wing pattern (not the card).
contrast: Pair with mot. The only difference is the thing: wings folded upright and thin knobbed antennae here, wings lying flat and feathery antennae there.
example_nl: Er zit een vlinder op de bloem.
example_en: There is a butterfly on the flower.
alt: Een slank insect met twee grote rechtopstaande vleugels en dunne sprieten met knopjes zit op een blad.

scene: A moth resting on the edge of a plain leaf, seen slightly from the side: a thick furry body, wings lying flat over the back like a low roof with simple vein lines, and two short feathery antennae that look like small ferns. No pattern on the wings, no lamp.
must: wings lying flat like a roof and short feathery antennae.
avoid: wings folded upright with thin clubbed antennae (vlinder); a fly (not the card); a moth flying around a lamp (not the card); a beetle (not the card).
contrast: Pair with vlinder. The only difference is the thing: wings lying flat and feathery antennae here, wings folded upright and thin knobbed antennae there.
example_nl: Er zit een mot in de kast.
example_en: There is a moth in the cupboard.
alt: Een dik harig insect met plat liggende vleugels als een dak en korte veervormige sprieten zit op een blad.

scene: A donkey standing side-on on a grass line beside a low plain fence: a stocky body, a large head, very long upright ears, a short upright mane, thin legs with small hooves and a thin tail ending in a tuft. No saddle, no cart, no rider.
must: very long upright ears and a thin tail ending in a tuft.
avoid: short ears, a long flowing mane and a full tail (pony); a horse (not the card); a rabbit (konijn); a donkey pulling a cart (not the card).
contrast: Pair with pony. The only difference is the thing: very long ears and a tufted tail here, short ears, a thick mane and a full tail there.
example_nl: De ezel staat in de wei.
example_en: The donkey stands in the meadow.
alt: Een stevig dier met heel lange rechtopstaande oren en een dunne staart met een pluim staat bij een hek.

scene: A pony standing side-on on a grass line beside a low plain fence: a small round body, short legs, small pointed ears, a thick long mane falling over the neck, a forelock over the eyes and a full flowing tail. No saddle, no rider.
must: short pointed ears, a thick long mane and a full flowing tail.
avoid: very long ears and a thin tufted tail (ezel); a tall horse (not the card); a foal (not the card); a pony with a rider (not the card).
contrast: Pair with ezel. The only difference is the thing: short ears, a thick mane and a full tail here, very long ears and a tufted tail there.
example_nl: Het meisje rijdt op een pony.
example_en: The girl rides a pony.
alt: Een klein rond dier met korte puntige oren, lange dikke haren in de nek en een volle staart staat bij een hek.

scene: An empty round bowl-shaped nest of woven twigs, wedged in the fork of a bare branch, seen side-on and a little from above so the hollow inside shows. A few loose twig ends stick out of the rim. No bird, no eggs, no cage, plain sky.
must: an empty round bowl of woven twigs in the fork of a branch.
avoid: a cage of thin bars with a small door (kooi); a birdhouse box with a round hole (not the card); a basket (mand); eggs without a bird (not the card).
contrast: Pair with kooi. The only difference is the thing: a bowl of woven twigs in a branch here, a cage of thin bars there.
example_nl: In de boom zit een nest.
example_en: There is a nest in the tree.
alt: Een lege ronde kom van gevlochten takjes ligt in de vork van een tak.

scene: An empty domed cage of thin upright bars with a small closed door, a perch across the middle and a flat base, hanging from a hook, seen side-on. No bird, no nest, plain background.
must: an empty domed cage of thin bars with a small closed door and a perch.
avoid: a round nest of twigs in a branch (nest); a birdhouse box (not the card); a basket (mand); a fence (hek).
contrast: Pair with nest. The only difference is the thing: a cage of thin bars here, a bowl of woven twigs in a branch there.
example_nl: We maken de kooi elke week schoon.
example_en: We clean the cage every week.
alt: Een lege ronde koepel van dunne spijlen met een stokje en een klein dicht deurtje hangt aan een haak.

scene: A bird standing side-on on a ground line, wings folded, with a small ring around its tail: a fan of long tail feathers sticking out behind the body. The ring is plain cobalt line and the tail is shown at normal size; the legs and wings are drawn but not ringed.
must: a ring around the fan of feathers at the back of the bird.
avoid: a ring around the leg and foot (poot); a ring around the wing (vleugel); a dog's tail (not the card); a ring around the beak (not the card).
contrast: Pair with poot and vleugel. The only difference is the ringed part: the fan of feathers at the back here, the leg or the folded wing there.
example_nl: De vogel heeft een lange staart.
example_en: The bird has a long tail.
alt: Een vogel staat op de grond, met een cirkel om de waaier van veren achter het lijf.

scene: The same bird standing side-on, wings folded, with a small ring around one leg: a thin scaly leg ending in a foot with three toes pointing forward and one back, gripping the ground. Shown at normal size; the tail and wings are drawn but not ringed.
must: a ring around the thin leg and clawed foot on the ground.
avoid: a ring around the tail (staart); a ring around the wing (vleugel); a human foot (voet); a dog's paw (not the card).
contrast: Pair with staart and vleugel. The only difference is the ringed part: the thin leg and foot here, the tail or the folded wing there.
example_nl: De vogel staat op één poot.
example_en: The bird stands on one leg.
alt: Dezelfde vogel staat op de grond, met een cirkel om het dunne been met tenen.

scene: The same bird standing side-on, with a small ring around its folded wing: the long feathered shape lying along the side of the body, with rows of feathers and longer flight feathers at the tip. Shown at normal size; the bird does not fly.
must: a ring around the folded feathered shape on the side of the body.
avoid: a ring around the tail (staart); a ring around the leg and foot (poot); a bird with wings spread in flight (not the card); an aeroplane wing (not the card).
contrast: Pair with staart and poot. The only difference is the ringed part: the folded wing on the side here, the tail or the leg there.
example_nl: De vogel heeft een gebroken vleugel.
example_en: The bird has a broken wing.
alt: Dezelfde vogel staat op de grond, met een cirkel om de gevederde vorm langs het lijf.

scene: A narrow stream winding across a grassy field from the back to the front of the picture, seen from slightly above, with small ripple lines showing that it flows and a few stones along its banks. No bridge, no person, plain sky.
must: a narrow winding strip of flowing water with ripple lines.
avoid: a round still pond with reeds (vijver); a wide river with boats (not the card); a ditch with straight sides (not the card); a waterfall (not the card).
contrast: Pair with vijver. The only difference is the thing: a narrow winding strip of flowing water here, a round still pond there.
example_nl: De kinderen spelen bij de beek.
example_en: The children play by the stream.
alt: Een smal kronkelend stroompje water met rimpels loopt door het gras.

scene: A round still pond in the middle of a grassy field, seen from slightly above, with a smooth surface, a few reeds and two lily pads at the edge, and nothing flowing in or out. No duck, no person, plain sky.
must: a round still pond with reeds at the edge and nothing flowing.
avoid: a narrow winding stream (beek); a lake reaching the horizon (not the card); a swimming pool with straight edges (not the card); a puddle on a road (not the card).
contrast: Pair with beek. The only difference is the thing: a round still pond here, a narrow winding stream there.
example_nl: In de vijver zwemmen kleine vissen.
example_en: Small fish swim in the pond.
alt: Een rond stil water met riet aan de rand ligt midden in het gras.

scene: A wide landscape of dry rolling sand under plain sky, seen from the front: low smooth dunes with wind ripple lines and one tall cactus with two arms. No water, no other plants, no person, no animal.
must: dry rolling sand with ripple lines and no water.
avoid: wet ground with reeds and pools (moeras); a beach beside the sea (not the card); a sandpit in a playground (not the card); a camel caravan (not the card).
contrast: Pair with moeras. The only difference is the thing: dry rolling sand here, wet ground with reeds and pools there.
example_nl: Het is heet in de woestijn.
example_en: It is hot in the desert.
alt: Een groot droog landschap van zand met golvende lijnen en één cactus.

scene: A wide landscape of wet ground under plain sky, seen from the front: tufts of grass and tall reeds standing in many small pools of still water, with a few bare tree stumps. No sand dunes, no path, no person.
must: tall reeds and tufts of grass standing in pools of still water.
avoid: dry rolling sand with a cactus (woestijn); a lake with open water (not the card); a ditch beside a road (not the card); a flooded street (not the card).
contrast: Pair with woestijn. The only difference is the thing: wet ground with reeds and pools here, dry rolling sand there.
example_nl: Pas op, je zakt weg in het moeras.
example_en: Careful, you sink into the marsh.
alt: Een groot nat landschap met hoog riet en plukken gras tussen plassen stil water.

scene: The same small sailing boat seen side-on, with an anchor lying on the front deck: a straight shank with an eye at the top and two curved hooked arms, a short coil of chain beside it. A small ring circles the anchor; the sail and mast are drawn but not ringed.
must: a ring around the hooked anchor lying on the front deck.
avoid: a ring around the sail (zeil); a ring around the mast (mast); an anchor tattoo (not the card); a hook on a fishing line (not the card).
contrast: Pair with zeil and mast. The only difference is the ringed part: the hooked anchor on the deck here, the sail or the mast there.
example_nl: De schipper gooit het anker uit.
example_en: The skipper drops the anchor.
alt: Een klein bootje ligt stil op het water, met een cirkel om de haak op het voordek.

scene: The same small sailing boat seen side-on, with a small ring around its sail: a large triangle of cloth fixed along the mast and the boom, slightly curved by the wind, with two seam lines. The mast and the hull are drawn but not ringed.
must: a ring around the large triangle of cloth.
avoid: a ring around the anchor (anker); a ring around the mast (mast); a flag on a pole (not the card); a tent (not the card).
contrast: Pair with anker and mast. The only difference is the ringed part: the triangle of cloth here, the anchor or the mast there.
example_nl: De wind blaast in het zeil.
example_en: The wind blows into the sail.
alt: Hetzelfde bootje, met een cirkel om de grote driehoek van doek.

scene: The same small sailing boat seen side-on, with a small ring around its mast: the tall straight pole standing upright in the middle of the hull, from the deck to above the top of the sail. The sail is drawn but not ringed.
must: a ring around the tall upright pole in the middle of the boat.
avoid: a ring around the sail (zeil); a ring around the anchor (anker); a flagpole on land (not the card); a lamp post (not the card).
contrast: Pair with anker and zeil. The only difference is the ringed part: the tall upright pole here, the sail or the anchor there.
example_nl: Er zit een vogel boven op de mast.
example_en: A bird is sitting on top of the mast.
alt: Hetzelfde bootje, met een cirkel om de hoge rechte paal in het midden.

scene: An open garden fence running across the whole picture on a grass line: thin upright metal bars with gaps between them, joined by two horizontal rails, so the grass and a small bush behind it are clearly visible through the gaps. Plain sky, no gate.
must: thin upright bars with gaps you can see through.
avoid: a closed fence of wooden boards (schutting); a brick wall (not the card); a hedge (not the card); a gate standing open (not the card).
contrast: Pair with schutting. The only difference is the thing: thin bars with gaps you can see through here, closed boards with no gaps there.
example_nl: De hond springt over het hek.
example_en: The dog jumps over the fence.
alt: Dunne rechtopstaande staven met ruimte ertussen staan in een rij; je ziet het gras erachter.

scene: A closed garden fence running across the whole picture on a grass line: wide wooden boards standing side by side with no gaps, wood grain lines and a few nail heads, so nothing behind it is visible. Plain sky, no gate.
must: wide boards side by side with no gaps.
avoid: thin bars with gaps you can see through (hek); a brick wall (not the card); a hedge (not the card); a wooden door (deur).
contrast: Pair with hek. The only difference is the thing: closed boards with no gaps here, thin bars you can see through there.
example_nl: De buren hebben een hoge schutting.
example_en: The neighbours have a high fence.
alt: Brede houten planken staan dicht tegen elkaar; erachter zie je niets.

scene: A made bed seen from the side and a little above, with one plain pillow at the head and a thin flat woollen blanket spread over the mattress: it lies close to the mattress, hangs straight down at the side and has a stitched border along its edge. No person, no pattern.
must: a thin flat cover lying close to the mattress with a stitched border.
avoid: a thick puffy cover with stitched squares (dekbed); a sheet (laken); a towel (handdoek); a rug on the floor (not the card).
contrast: Pair with dekbed. The only difference is the thing: a thin flat cover here, a thick puffy cover with stitched squares there.
example_nl: Het is koud, pak een extra deken.
example_en: It is cold, take an extra blanket.
alt: Een dunne platte lap met een gestikte rand ligt over een matras met één kussen.

scene: The same made bed seen from the side and a little above, with the same plain pillow, and a thick puffy duvet spread over the mattress: it rises well above the mattress, is quilted into soft stitched squares and folds over at the top edge. No person, no pattern.
must: a thick puffy cover quilted into stitched squares.
avoid: a thin flat cover with a stitched border (deken); a sleeping bag (not the card); a mattress (not the card); a pile of pillows (not the card).
contrast: Pair with deken. The only difference is the thing: a thick puffy cover with stitched squares here, a thin flat cover there.
example_nl: In de winter slaap ik onder een warm dekbed.
example_en: In winter I sleep under a warm duvet.
alt: Een dikke bolle laag met gestikte vakken ligt over een matras met één kussen.

scene: The same house cross-section with a ring around the room below the ground line: a low room under the floor with a steep stair coming down into it and a few boxes and jars on a shelf. The rooms above and the roof are drawn but not ringed.
must: a ring around the room below the ground line.
avoid: a ring around the space under the roof (zolder); a garage beside the house (not the card); a tunnel (not the card); a cave (not the card).
contrast: Pair with zolder. The only difference is the ringed space: the room below the ground here, the space under the roof there.
example_nl: De fietsen staan in de kelder.
example_en: The bicycles are in the cellar.
alt: Een huis in doorsnede, met een cirkel om de ruimte onder de grond met een steile trap en een plank met potten.

scene: The same house cross-section with a ring around the space under the pointed roof: a triangular room under the roof beams with a small roof window, a hatch in the floor and a few boxes. The rooms below and the room under the ground are drawn but not ringed.
must: a ring around the triangular space under the roof.
avoid: a ring around the room below the ground (kelder); a balcony (balkon); a chimney (not the card); a tree house (not the card).
contrast: Pair with kelder. The only difference is the ringed space: the space under the roof here, the room below the ground there.
example_nl: Onze oude spullen liggen op zolder.
example_en: Our old things are in the attic.
alt: Hetzelfde huis, met een cirkel om de driehoekige ruimte onder het dak met een dakraampje.

scene: The front of a block of flats with a paved floor at ground level in front of the door, and on it a small round table with two chairs. The upper floors have plain windows and no ledges. Plain sky, no person, no umbrella.
must: a table with chairs on a paved floor at ground level.
avoid: a table on a railed ledge upstairs (balkon); a cafe with a signboard (not the card); a garden with grass (not the card); a roof terrace (not the card).
contrast: Pair with balkon. The only difference is the thing: the table on the paved ground here, on a railed ledge upstairs there.
example_nl: In de zomer eten we op het terras.
example_en: In summer we eat on the terrace.
alt: Een rond tafeltje met twee stoelen staat op de stenen vloer voor de deur van een flatgebouw.

scene: The front of the same block of flats with a ledge sticking out from an upper floor, closed by a railing of upright bars, and on it the same small round table with two chairs. The ground in front of the door is empty. Plain sky, no person.
must: a table with chairs on a railed ledge on an upper floor.
avoid: a table on the paved ground floor (terras); a window box with plants (not the card); a fire escape stair (not the card); a roof terrace (not the card).
contrast: Pair with terras. The only difference is the thing: the table on a railed ledge upstairs here, on the paved ground there.
example_nl: Mijn balkon kijkt uit op de tuin.
example_en: My balcony looks out over the garden.
alt: Hetzelfde flatgebouw, met een uitstekende vloer met hekwerk hoog aan de gevel en daarop een tafeltje met twee stoelen.

scene: An empty woven basket standing on the floor line, seen side-on: an oval body of crossing woven strips, a thick rim and a curved woven handle arching over the top from side to side. Nothing inside, no cloth, no lid.
must: a body of crossing woven strips with a curved handle over the top.
avoid: a smooth metal bucket with a thin wire handle (emmer); a laundry basket with no handle (not the card); a handbag (not the card); a box (doos).
contrast: Pair with emmer. The only difference is the thing: woven strips with a woven handle here, smooth metal with a wire handle there.
example_nl: Oma neemt een mand mee naar de markt.
example_en: Grandma takes a basket to the market.
alt: Een lege bak van gevlochten repen met een gebogen hengsel erover staat op de vloer.

scene: An empty metal bucket standing on the floor line, seen side-on: smooth walls that widen toward the top, a rolled rim, two small clips on the sides and a thin wire handle arching over the top. Nothing inside, no mop.
must: smooth widening walls with a thin wire handle.
avoid: a woven basket with a curved woven handle (mand); a watering can with a spout (not the card); a cooking pot (not the card); a bin with a lid (not the card).
contrast: Pair with mand. The only difference is the thing: smooth metal with a wire handle here, woven strips with a woven handle there.
example_nl: Hij vult de emmer met water.
example_en: He fills the bucket with water.
alt: Een lege gladde bak die naar boven breder wordt, met een dun ijzeren hengsel, staat op de vloer.

scene: An adult face close up from the nose to the chin, mouth wide open as when saying aah, with a small ring around the tongue: the soft rounded shape lying on the floor of the mouth behind the lower teeth, with a line down its middle. Teeth and lips are drawn but not ringed.
must: a ring around the soft rounded shape on the floor of the mouth.
avoid: a ring around one tooth (tand); a ring around the lower lip (lip); a tongue sticking out (not the card); a dog's tongue (not the card).
contrast: Pair with tand and lip. The only difference is the ringed part: the soft shape on the floor of the mouth here, one tooth or the lower lip there.
example_nl: De soep is heet, pas op je tong.
example_en: The soup is hot, mind your tongue.
alt: Een wijd open mond van dichtbij, met een cirkel om het zachte ronde deel achter de onderste rij.

scene: The same open mouth close up, with a small ring around one front tooth in the upper row: a single tooth with a flat biting edge and a smooth front, among the other teeth. Tongue and lips are drawn but not ringed.
must: a ring around one single front tooth in the upper row.
avoid: a ring around the tongue (tong); a ring around the lower lip (lip); a toothbrush (tandenborstel); an animal's fang (not the card).
contrast: Pair with tong and lip. The only difference is the ringed part: one front tooth here, the tongue or the lower lip there.
example_nl: Ik poets mijn tanden twee keer per dag.
example_en: I brush my teeth twice a day.
alt: Dezelfde open mond, met een cirkel om één voorste element in de bovenste rij.

scene: The same open mouth close up, with a small ring around the lower lip: the soft curved edge below the opening, with a faint line marking its border and small upright creases. Tongue and teeth are drawn but not ringed.
must: a ring around the soft curved lower edge of the mouth.
avoid: a ring around the tongue (tong); a ring around one tooth (tand); a lipstick (not the card); a moustache (snor).
contrast: Pair with tong and tand. The only difference is the ringed part: the soft lower edge of the mouth here, the tongue or one tooth there.
example_nl: Mijn lip is droog van de kou.
example_en: My lip is dry from the cold.
alt: Dezelfde open mond, met een cirkel om de zachte gebogen onderrand.

scene: The same adult head as the gezicht set, seen three-quarter from the front with a neutral mouth and no hair detail, with a small ring around the cheek: the soft round area between the nose, the ear and the jaw. The eye, nose and mouth are drawn but not ringed.
must: a ring around the round area beside the nose.
avoid: a ring around the chin (kin); a ring around the forehead (voorhoofd); a ring around the nose (neus); a ring around the ear (oor).
contrast: Pair with kin and voorhoofd. The only difference is the ringed part: the round area beside the nose here, the chin or the forehead there.
example_nl: Ze geeft haar oma een kus op de wang.
example_en: She gives her grandma a kiss on the cheek.
alt: Een gezicht schuin van voren, met een cirkel om het ronde zachte deel naast de neus.

scene: The same head seen three-quarter from the front, with a small ring around the chin: the rounded point at the bottom of the face below the lower lip. The eye, nose and mouth are drawn but not ringed.
must: a ring around the rounded point below the mouth.
avoid: a ring around the cheek (wang); a ring around the forehead (voorhoofd); a beard (baard); a ring around the mouth (not the card).
contrast: Pair with wang and voorhoofd. The only difference is the ringed part: the rounded point below the mouth here, the cheek or the forehead there.
example_nl: Hij heeft een litteken op zijn kin.
example_en: He has a scar on his chin.
alt: Hetzelfde gezicht, met een cirkel om de ronde punt onderaan, onder de mond.

scene: The same head seen three-quarter from the front, with a small ring around the forehead: the wide flat area above the eyebrows and below the hairline. The eye, nose and mouth are drawn but not ringed.
must: a ring around the flat area above the eyebrows.

avoid: long narrow stripes across the body (tijger); a cheetah with small solid dots (not the card); a house cat (kat); a car (auto).

alt: Een hoge toren van open vakwerk met een lange arm bovenop en een haak aan een kabel.

scene: A snake lying coiled on a grass line, seen from slightly above: a long smooth body with scale lines, a narrow head raised a little, two small eyes and a thin forked tongue flicking out. No nozzle, no tap, no pattern on the skin.

avoid: a coiled garden hose with a nozzle (slang-tuin); a worm (not the card); a rope (touw); an eel in water (not the card).

alt: Een lang opgerold dier met schubben, een opgeheven kopje en een gespleten tong ligt in het gras.

avoid: a coiled snake with a head and tongue (slang-dier); an electric cable (kabel); a rope (touw); a fire hose on a truck (not the card).
